name: @sleep2agi/agent-network
description: AI Agent Network — Server + Client + Setup in one package. SSE real-time communication for multi-agent orchestration.

scripts.build: bun build src/client.ts --outdir dist/src --target node --minify && bun build bin/cli.ts --outdir dist/bin --target node --minify --external @sleep2agi/commhub-server --external bun:sqlite --external '../../server/*' && bun build src/node-server.ts --outdir dist/src --target node --minify --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist && npx javascript-obfuscator dist/bin/cli.js --output dist/bin/cli.js --compact true --control-flow-flattening true --string-array true --string-array-encoding base64 && npx javascript-obfuscator dist/src/client.js --output dist/src/client.js --compact true --string-array true && npx javascript-obfuscator dist/src/node-server.js --output dist/src/node-server.js --compact true --string-array true

author: sleep2agi
